title: a PROC's SYSIN DD DSN=LIB(&CARDS): the effective step takes the card member from the PROC default, not the job's CARDS= override

checks.sql: SELECT d.card_member FROM dd d JOIN step s ON s.id=d.step_id JOIN job j ON j.id=s.job_id WHERE s.step_name='WEEK3.SRT010' AND d.dd_name='SYSIN'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card_field_ref c JOIN step s ON s.id=c.step_id WHERE s.step_name='WEEK3.SRT010'
